reasons: Preferred level is complete: Affiliate and contractor coverage, perpetual/irrevocable paid-up (and now Deliverable) licence, revocation limited to uncured material breach via Section 13.3, and successor transferability all appear in operative text.

Minimality fails: the single operation rewrites the whole second sentence of 14.2, expanding 17 words to 52 (official gate: ratio 3.06 > 1.50; changed-character ratio 0.793 > 0.600). Fixing perpetuity, party scope, transferability and revocation could have been done with a tighter edit (e.g. striking "revocable, non-transferable" and "only during the applicable Order Form term" and adding a short cross-reference to Sections 13.2-13.3).

Added commercial terms not required to reach the selected level ('worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid', 'for their internal business purposes') duplicate protections already granted in Sections 13.1-13.2.

Intent preserved: Vendor's exclusive ownership of Deliverables is untouched, and the cross-references to Sections 13.3 and 24 are existing, defined mechanics, so no dangling term or contradiction is introduced.
